steps: Wait for applications to reopen — the official apply page (speechpad.com/worker/apply) currently says 'Applications Closed... at capacity for new transcriptionist applications and don't anticipate openings in the near future'; follow their socials for reopening.
When applications reopen, go through the official application process and score above 98 on the basic transcription test and 75 or above on the grammar test (per the official FAQ).
Once you get a worker account, go to the Qualifications section and complete the Confidentiality Qualification — read and digitally sign the Worker Confidentiality Agreement.
Start with entry-level general transcription jobs from the job board at $0.25 per audio minute; use the 30-second audio preview before accepting a job to check quality.
Submit completed transcripts; each job is reviewed by another qualified worker and must be approved to become eligible for payment in the next cycle.
Get paid every Thursday via PayPal (generally midnight GMT) for all approved jobs since the previous payment; no processing fees are deducted.
Build ratings and complete minutes to unlock higher pay: verbatim jobs, rush jobs (500 minutes + 96 rating, invitation), and reviewer roles (1,000 minutes + 98 rating, invitation).
timing: Paid every Thursday (generally midnight GMT) via PayPal; each payment includes all jobs submitted and approved since the previous payment.
